name: Sakura-sou no Pet na Kanojo
original_name: さくら荘のペットな彼女
source:
Sakura Dormitory is a dorm of the high school affiliated with Suimei University of the Arts (often shortened as Suiko), which hosts the strangest, trouble-making students. After being kicked out of the normal dorm for keeping a stray cat, [url=/c25971]Kanda Sorata[/url] moves into Sakura Dormitory. As he starts to get used to the life in the dorm, [url=/c25927]Shiina Mashiro[/url], a world famous artist who cannot even take care of her daily life, moves in. Sorata is forced to become Mashiro's handler. The story is about their daily life as well as mental growth.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakura-sō_no_Pet_na_Kanojo]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
樱花庄是水明艺术大学附属高中的宿舍，住着最奇怪、最爱惹麻烦的学生。因为养流浪猫而被赶出普通宿舍后，[url=/c25971]神田空太[/url]搬进了樱花庄。当他开始适应宿舍生活时，连日常生活都无法自理的世界级画家[url=/c25927]椎名真白[/url]搬了进来。空太被迫成为真白的负责人。故事讲述了他们的日常生活以及心灵的成长。

[编辑自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakura-sō_no_Pet_na_Kanojo]Wikipedia[/url]]
